items.headline: 三种海洋信号追踪厄尔尼诺
items.headline_en: Three ocean signals track El Niño
items.summary: NASA 10月15日展示海温、海面高度和海色观测：热带太平洋中东部偏暖、海面偏高，浮游植物减少使海水更蓝。信风减弱会抑制富营养深水上涌。多种信号帮助理解气候与海洋生态变化，但不能单独确定某地未来天气。
items.summary_en: NASA's October 15 report combines sea temperature, sea level and ocean colour observations. The central and eastern tropical Pacific is warmer, sea levels are higher, and fewer phytoplankton make the water bluer. Weaker trade winds reduce nutrient-rich upwelling. Together, these signals help explain climate and marine ecosystem changes, but cannot alone determine future weather in a particular place.

items.headline: 冰崖崩塌之后，不一定持续失稳
items.headline_en: Ice-cliff collapse need not trigger runaway retreat
items.summary: MIT 10月15日报道，研究者用2019—2023年卫星资料分析逾15000处南极冰崖。部分高冰崖退缩很快，却随后稳定；冰层变薄和冰下地形高地可能阻止连续崩塌。这提示海平面模型需考虑更多因素，并不表示南极融冰风险消失。
items.summary_en: MIT reported on October 15 that researchers analysed more than 15,000 Antarctic ice cliffs using satellite data from 2019–2023. Some tall cliffs retreated rapidly but then stabilised. Thinning ice and rises in the underlying terrain may interrupt continued collapse. Sea-level models need to consider these factors; the finding does not remove the risks from Antarctic ice loss.

source.name: 麻省理工学院 / MIT News

items.headline: 愿意使用数字服务，不等于更信任政府
items.headline_en: Digital-service interest and government trust can diverge
items.summary: MIT 10月15日介绍一项9月刊出的肯尼亚研究。逾11000人收到不同的政务平台介绍；相较强调政府的版本，只强调合作企业提高了使用意愿，却降低了政府信任。研究提示服务宣传会影响人们如何归功；问卷中的意愿不等于实际长期行为。
items.summary_en: On October 15, MIT described a Kenyan study published in September. More than 11,000 people received different descriptions of a public-service portal. Compared with crediting government, crediting only its corporate partner increased willingness to use the service but reduced trust in government. Messaging can shape who receives credit; survey intentions do not establish long-term behaviour.

source.name: 麻省理工学院 / MIT News

items.headline: 微生物的演化，可能改变化石保存
items.headline_en: Microbial evolution may shape the fossil record
items.summary: 剑桥大学10月8日报道，研究者比对700个细菌基因组与演化时间树，追踪分解胶原蛋白的酶如何传播。这类酶进入需氧细菌，可能加快遗体腐烂，减少软组织保存机会。研究为化石记录缺口提供新解释；这是演化重建支持的假说，并非直接观察古代腐烂过程。
items.summary_en: Cambridge reported on October 8 that researchers compared 700 bacterial genomes with a dated evolutionary tree to trace collagen-digesting enzymes. Their spread into oxygen-using bacteria may have accelerated decay, reducing the chance of soft tissues becoming fossils. The study offers a new explanation for gaps in the fossil record; this is a hypothesis supported by evolutionary reconstruction, not direct observation of ancient decay.

source.name: 剑桥大学 / University of Cambridge

items.headline: 火星卫星取样任务确认发射计划
items.headline_en: Mars-moon mission confirms its launch plan
items.summary: JAXA 10月18日确认，MMX计划于北京时间20日凌晨3时41分发射。探测器将用火卫一表面的中子和伽马射线推断元素组成，并计划取样返地。这些线索可帮助区分卫星源于小行星捕获还是巨大撞击；目前仍在发射前，取样和返回均是未来目标。
items.summary_en: On October 18, JAXA confirmed MMX's planned launch for October 20 at 3:41 a.m. Beijing time. It will use neutrons and gamma rays from Phobos to infer elemental composition and aims to return samples to Earth. These clues could distinguish asteroid capture from a giant-impact origin for Mars' moons. The mission remains pre-launch; sampling and return are future goals.

source.name: 日本宇宙航空研究开发机构 / JAXA

items.headline: 新型电池“胶水”让回收更容易
items.headline_en: A new battery binder could simplify recycling
items.summary: 10月9日发表的研究提出不含氟、可用水加工的电池黏结剂：柠檬酸连接两种聚合物，稳固电极，也让拆解后的电极涂层在水中与金属箔分离。实验电池保持良好性能，为更清洁的制造与回收提供思路；商业化放大仍待完成。
items.summary_en: A study published on October 9 introduced a fluorine-free, water-processable battery binder. Citric acid links two polymers to hold electrodes together while allowing coatings to separate from metal foils in water after disassembly. Test batteries maintained strong performance in controlled laboratory tests, suggesting cleaner manufacturing and recycling; scaling up for commercial production remains a future step.

source.name: 加州大学圣迭戈分校 / UC San Diego

previous_answers.headline: 把1至9各用一次，排在一个圆周上。每三个相邻位置的数相加，共得到九个和。这九个和中的最大值，最小能是多少？先试排，再证明你的答案最优。
previous_answers.headline_en: Arrange 1–9 around a circle, using each number once. Add each group of three consecutive numbers to obtain nine sums. What is the smallest possible value of the largest sum? Experiment, then prove your answer is optimal.
previous_answers.explanation: 九个和合计135，平均15。若最大值≤15，则全为15；相邻两和相减会使相隔三位的数相同，矛盾。因此至少16。圆周排列1、5、8、2、6、7、3、4、9的九个和都不超过16，达到下界。
previous_answers.explanation_en: The nine sums total 135, averaging 15. A maximum of 15 would make all sums equal; subtracting neighbouring sums would force entries three places apart to match. Thus the integer maximum is at least 16. The circular order 1,5,8,2,6,7,3,4,9 attains 16.
previous_answers.subject: W42 · 圆周极值解答

previous_answers.eyebrow: 上期思考题参考解答 / PREVIOUS ANSWER
previous_answers.headline: 两枚公平六面骰子独立掷出，已知点数不同。只看第一枚，决定保留第二枚或独立重掷第二枚一次；决定前不看第二枚，重掷后必须用新点数，可与第一枚相同。最终点数和至少为8算赢。求最优策略与最大胜率。
previous_answers.headline_en: Two fair six-sided dice are rolled independently; their results are known to differ. Seeing only the first, choose to keep the hidden second die or reroll it once independently. You must accept the new result, even if it equals the first. A final sum of at least 8 wins. Find the optimal strategy and maximum win probability.
previous_answers.explanation: 第一枚仍均匀分布。保留时第二枚有5种可能，重掷后有6种。第一枚为2或3时保留，为4、5或6时重掷，为1时任选。最优胜率为(0＋1/5＋2/5＋1/2＋2/3＋5/6)/6＝13/30。
previous_answers.explanation_en: The first die is still uniform. Keeping leaves five possible hidden values; rerolling gives six. Keep for first-die values 2 or 3; reroll for 4, 5 or 6; either for 1. The optimal probability is (0+1/5+2/5+1/2+2/3+5/6)/6=13/30.
previous_answers.subject: W42 · 条件概率决策解答

previous_answers.headline: 六个点两两相连，每条连线涂红或蓝。三条边同色的三角形，最少能有几个？请证明下界，并画出达到下界的涂色方案。挑战：能否让红色、蓝色三角形各恰好一个？
previous_answers.headline_en: Join every pair of six points, colouring each edge red or blue. What is the minimum number of triangles with all three edges the same colour? Prove a lower bound and draw a colouring that attains it. Bonus: can there be exactly one red triangle and one blue triangle?
previous_answers.result_en: Minimum: 2; one of each colour is possible
previous_answers.explanation: 每点有d条红边，则一红一蓝的边对有d(5−d)≤6个。每个非同色三角形被数两次，故至多18个；20个三角形中至少2个同色。点标为1至6，红边取12、15、16、24、26、34、35，其余为蓝：仅红126、蓝456同色。
previous_answers.explanation_en: A vertex with d red edges has d(5−d)≤6 mixed-colour edge pairs. Each non-monochromatic triangle contributes two pairs, so at most 18 of 20 triangles are non-monochromatic. Label the points 1–6. Colour edges 12,15,16,24,26,34,35 red and all others blue: only red 126 and blue 456 are monochromatic.
previous_answers.subject: W42 · 组合计数证明解答

challenges.headline: 5×5方格起初全白。每步可选一整行或一整列，把其中所有格子黑白互换。若最终至少有一个黑格，黑格最少能有几个？给出做法，并证明不能更少。
challenges.headline_en: A 5×5 grid starts entirely white. Each move flips every cell in one whole row or column between black and white. If at least one cell ends black, what is the smallest possible number of black cells? Give a construction and prove it is minimal.

challenges.headline_en: Keep tossing a fair coin independently until HHT or HTH first appears as three consecutive results (H=heads, T=tails). Which pattern is more likely to appear first? Find its probability and justify your answer.

challenges.headline_en: Choose distinct integers from 1 to 60. Your set must not contain a<b<c with b a multiple of a and c a multiple of b. What is the largest possible number of selected integers? Give an example and prove optimality.
